item.title: Airport West — History and How It's Changed
item.description:

What Airport West Was Originally

Before it was what you see today, Airport West was built around industry and working families. The original residents built the suburb’s foundation — the street grid, the housing stock, the community institutions that still exist in some form.

item.title: Cost of Living in Airport West Melbourne
item.description:

Is Airport West Expensive?

Airport West is one of Melbourne’s more affordable options — especially considering what you get for your money. It won’t stay this cheap forever.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Airport West, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.
